confidence_notes: FX is from one RBA search. The 18 Nov 2026 value of 0.6720 is the confirmed 4pm rate. A 19 Nov figure of 0.6677 appeared but may be provisional, so I used the confirmed one. Food and drink figures come from one search of aggregated cost-of-living data: Numbeo via Expatica (June 2026) gave an inexpensive meal of about €17.70, a mid-range meal for two of about €73 and a 0.5 L draught beer of about €5.30. A cappuccino at about €4.15 came from MyLifeElsewhere. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass prices were not found directly, so I estimated them from the local beer price. Cocktails are set at about 2.3 times beer and a glass of wine at about 1.1 times beer. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. July is peak season, with the Salzburg Festival pushing prices up, so those figures are the most uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other high-priced Central European tourist cities such as Innsbruck and Munich, with Salzburg slightly cheaper than Munich for dining and with festival-season peak accommodation pricing.
